quotes.verbatim: ここでは、STMB caveというドネイトについて紹介していきます。
STMB caveの名前の由来は、STMB caveを紹介していた人が名前に付けていたタグ(STMB)と、ドネイトの形状(cave=洞穴)から付けられているそうです。
※投稿主であるI凜さんに許可を得た上で動画を掲載しています。
基本形とラインの消し方
STMB caveは、左右の高さが同じ3列の幅があるときに%S(%Z)を引っ掛けて、反対側に%Z(%S)を立てることでTSDの形を作るドネイトです。
STMB caveは1段削るだけで、下穴に干渉せずTSDを作ることができます。
そのため、TSDの地形でSTMB caveを行うと連続してTSDを狙うことができます。
以下の様な形の場合、%Lを寝かせることによって、同等の形を作ることができます。

nodes.label: the terrain: a 3-wide gap, both sides level
an S hooked over the gap and a Z stood on the other side: the TSD slot over the cave
the gap over a TSD terrain (a hole under its middle column)
the T laid flat into the slot, the stack around it filled up: a TSD clearing one row of the gap
what the TSD leaves: the cave over the TSD terrain, roofed for a second TSD
the similar terrain: a 4-wide gap over a 3-wide one
an L laid flat makes the same shape, mirrored (an I under the hooked side)

nodes.reading: basic.build less its z and s: the gap one column right of where basic.terrain draws it
feature.spin less its T: the board the T went into

variants.window_note: in feature.spin's frame, row 0 the top: the AGREEMENT BOX of every drawing in `agreement` and harddrop's four positive STMB_Cave diagrams. Rows 2-3 are the two rows the TSD clears (entailed by the clear at a full TSD, NaiveClauseForced: the nub row is the cave's roof, RoofForced); row 4 is the cave row: two filled cells behind the nub, the three cave cells empty, the far wall filled. Occupancy only, never colour; garbage is filled.

untested_drawn.reason: the J, Z, L and O above the T: feature.spin is the page's stacked board, and no other drawing of the shape agrees on these cells (the L at row 1, column 5 roofs the NEXT TSD, which the basic and similar forms and harddrop's diagrams do not draw), so they are outside the agreement box and not read

followup.note: the flat T into the TSD slot the cave sits on, which feature.after draws (one row shorter than feature.spin; compared bottom-aligned). It lies OUTSIDE the window: a hit on a terrain with no such slot is still an STMB Cave, and the follow-up reports it.

cross_source.note: the window, by the gate's predicate (technique_transcription.window_fires), over every U-slot board of every committed *-routes.json, with the U cells as the T. `fires` is the independent drawer (harddrop's SDPC Spin page, another author); `also` is measured and named, not explained. harddrop's own STMB_Cave diagrams are the window's `agreement` drawings, not a cross-check of it.

harddrop.mirrored_reading: OUR READING, checked: a diagram whose cave starts left of its nub is the mirrored hand; the agreement rule requires it to fire in exactly that orientation

fires.note: harddrop's SDPC Spin: the STMB Cave of its first C-Spin build, the cave left of the nub

known_discrepancies.note: the stacked board draws its J as three cells (column 0) and an L-coloured piece in a J's shape (row 1, columns 5-7, with row 2, column 7): the renderer's colours used loosely, read by occupancy only, which is all the matcher compares
feature.spin less its T, so the same two pieces as feature.spin:colour
the similar form's S-coloured piece is drawn in a Z's shape (rows 1-2, columns 6-8): read by occupancy; the page's own sentence names only the L laid flat

the basic form's terrain draws its gap in columns 3-5; the board built on it (basic.build) has the gap in columns 4-6. Read as the terrain drawn one column left; the build is checked on the terrain it stands on, derived (basic.build.terrain), and this module measures the shift.
